_note: Update this file when vendor prices change — never hardcode costs in Python.

kling._note: Cost per 5-second clip. Longer clips billed in 5s blocks.

image_gen._note: Per image generated or edited. seedream = cheap draft/test model; nano_banana = premium photoreal (verify on fal.ai).

upscale._note: Per still upscaled (final-render quality lift). aura_sr = faithful (real footage, no hallucination); clarity = creative (AI stills, adds detail). VERIFY both on fal.ai before the first paid run — fal endpoints + pricing shift monthly.

scene_intelligence._note: GPT-4.1 scene design per captioned frame. Cached after first run (then $0).

music._note: Per AI-generated track. suno = Suno wrapper. lyria_pro = Lyria 3 full song (~3min, Gemini API), lyria_clip = 30s draft. VERIFY Lyria prices on ai.google.dev / OpenRouter (preview pricing shifts).

higgsfield._note: Always 5s. Check higgsfield.ai for current pricing.

seedance._note: ByteDance Seedance via fal.ai, per 5s clip. VERIFY on fal.ai.

veo._note: Google Veo 3 via fal.ai, per 5s clip (native audio). VERIFY on fal.ai.

hailuo._note: MiniMax Hailuo via fal.ai, per 5s clip. VERIFY on fal.ai.

synclabs._note: SyncLabs lipsync-2 model. Check app.sync.so for current rates.

hedra._note: Hedra character-3 per generation. Check hedra.com for current rates.

voice._note: ElevenLabs Starter plan: ~25k characters per dollar.

sfx._note: Per clip, MMAudio-class video->audio atmosphere/foley via fal.ai (S30 Phase 2). VERIFY on fal.ai before the first paid run — placeholder from public pricing.

kie._note: MEASURED live 2026-07-19: 3s 720p = 67.5 Kie credits (22.5 cr/s, ~1c/credit => ~$0.225/s => $1.13 per 5s block at 720p). 1080p ~1.5x (VERIFY). Trial/720p output carried an 'abcmehoo' WATERMARK - check paid tier before client renders.
